decision.rule: ACCEPTED_WITH_DEFINED_SCOPE iff P1 and P2 both satisfy C1-C6 (scope: conditional dependence-aware inference with empirically supported block length on the registered current-classification survivor populations, explored 2000-2025 history; trio included in scope only if it also satisfies C1-C6). Otherwise PARTIALLY_VALIDATED with the failing criteria named. Significance of grid points never enters the decision.

criteria.threshold: A criterion holds for a population if it holds for >= 33 of 36 grid points (primary endpoint). The 36 points share events and are not independent checks.
criteria.C2_PLATEAU: max/min of CBB SE over b in {39,52,78,104} <= 1.25
criteria.C5_STATIONARITY: KPSS(z, bw 52) and CUSUM(z, bw 52) both not rejected at 5%
criteria.populationStatus: BLOCK_DESIGN_SUPPORTED iff C1-C4; STATIONARITY_NOT_CONTRADICTED iff C5-C6
criteria.methodDecision: ACCEPTED_WITH_DEFINED_SCOPE iff P1 and P2 both satisfy C1-C6 (scope: conditional dependence-aware inference with empirically supported block length on the registered current-classification survivor populations, explored 2000-2025 history; trio included in scope only if it also satisfies C1-C6). Otherwise PARTIALLY_VALIDATED with the failing criteria named. Significance of grid points never enters the decision.
notProvable: Mixing/weak stationarity cannot be proven by finite-sample diagnostics; non-rejection is not proof.
Survivorship: current classification conditions on survival.
Explored history; no untouched holdout; P2 shares calendar shocks with P1 (not independent).
